Correct choices: 5 ft by 12 ft; 1 ft by 60 ft; 6 ft by 10 ft; 4 ft by 15 ft. Not correct: 2 ft by 31 ft.
additions.sourceNotes: Original Claude-authored item (family: mc5_select_area). 4th Grade Math audit 2026-11-19 (#8, select-all with 4 correct); every choice recomputed by scripts/test-grade4-audit.cjs.
